name: MoltEVM spawner hooks authenticate any contract reporting initialized()
summary: MoltEVM 0x225da3d8 (mEVM) and the Moltling tokens it spawns per buyer (minimal-proxy clones of 0x509c44e5, each with its own Aerodrome WETH pool) gate mintFromSpawner and setExemptFromSpawner with onlySpawnerToken, which only requires msg.sender to be a contract whose initialized() returns true. 55 minutes after deployment, EOA 0x5e4c4572 had its contract 0xa6b9ea78 (initialized() = true) call mintFromSpawner on MoltEVM, minting 1,000,000 mEVM to itself, which it sold into the mEVM pool over the next transactions for 56.2 WETH. About a dozen others copied it against MoltEVM and the Moltlings over the following days, e.g. 0x4c452e82 minting 1e9 tokens of eleven Moltlings, the implementation and MoltEVM in 0x10b7ec56 and selling them for 11.26 WETH.

campaign.selection: transactions not listed above in which a contract other than MoltEVM 0x225da3d8 or a Moltling clone of 0x509c44e5 successfully called mintFromSpawner (0xc5623f54) on MoltEVM, its implementation or a Moltling (campaign.mjs --selectors 0xc5623f54, callers classified by code)

notes: Contracts: MoltEVM's source is verified; the Moltling implementation 0x509c44e5, created by MoltEVM in its deployment transaction, is unverified but the clones answer the same selectors (mintFromSpawner 0xc5623f54, setExemptFromSpawner 0x9720d1fc) and the trace shows the same onlySpawnerToken staticcall to the caller's initialized() (0x158ef93e). Only MoltEVM is listed because the anchor executed only it; each Moltling clone is a sibling deployment from the same template, created between blocks 43015874 and 43017207 (rule 9), so the later clone attacks belong to the campaign.

Anchor: campaign.mjs over mintFromSpawner from MoltEVM's deployment finds 149 successful calls; five are MoltEVM's own spawns for buyers and 144 come from attacker contracts, the earliest being 0x8f4d619c (block 43017341). The transaction BlockSec reported, 0x10b7ec56 (block 43018243), is a later copycat and is in the campaign. Earlier contract-creation transactions by the 0x10b7ec56 attacker 0x4c452e82 (funded by 0x8c826f79) exploited unrelated fake 'USDT' tokens with a similar spawner interface (e.g. 0xac779e88) and are not part of this incident.
Reset is MoltEVM's deployment (0x656db211, block 43015687, 2026-03-06 18:12 UTC), about 55 minutes before the anchor; resets.mjs finds no later change to the exploited path.

Loss is the WETH that the 17 MoltEVM/Moltling Aerodrome pools (PoolCreated events emitted by MoltEVM or its clones) lost in the 55 listed transactions sent by EOAs that had minted through an attacker contract, through block 43600000, priced by loss.mjs (78.31 WETH, $155,303). It counts each transaction's net pool outflow only; WETH these EOAs paid into the pools in other transactions is not netted, and sales of minted tokens routed by other EOAs are not counted. 0x5e4c4572 took 56.23 WETH, 0x4c452e82 11.32 and 0x60ef9bbc 8.61; the rest is under 1.1 WETH each. DefiLlama's 127k USD likely counts fewer actors.
